title: Level 3 (Advanced) - A-4
notes:
West leads the ♥K against 4♠. West's heart lead should be trumped by South. South's only possible losers are in the trump suit. South must hold his trump losers to 3 while, at the same time, avoid losing control of the hand.

If spades are 5-0 the contract has no chance. South can ensure his contract as long as trumps are no worse than 4-1. South should cash the ♠A and start playing diamonds and clubs.

The defense will be able to take 3 trump tricks, but they will not be able to draw all of South's trumps. If the defense ruffs a minor suit winner and forces South in hearts, South continues playing diamonds and clubs. South is always able to stay one step ahead in the battle for trump control.
